scene_description: A young girl wearing a white knit sweater, white hat, and red scarf stands outdoors in an autumn setting. She is holding a small green pumpkin. Around her are wooden crates filled with orange and green pumpkins, hay, and orange marigold flowers. Red, orange, and yellow fall leaves cover the trees and ground behind her.
